guide.mdvlcraft.page.1:
§lMDVLCraft§r

Your character is built from three origins and two classes.

Everything in this guide is in the menu: press §l%1$s§r.

The pages that follow cover each part.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.2:
§lOrigins§r

On first join you pick three:

§lRace§r - your people
§lJob§r - your trade
§lMartial§r - how you fight

Hover each one on the Status page (%1$s → Status) to read its powers.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.3:
§lChanging origins§r

An §lOrb of Origin§r resets all three and lets you choose again.

Craft it from an enchanted golden apple surrounded by 8 gold ingots.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.4:
§lClasses§r

Open %1$s → Skills → Classes and pick up to two archetypes.

Two together give you a combined class and a title shown in chat.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.5:
§lSkill trees§r

Each archetype has its own tree. You get 1 point to start and 1 per level, with no level cap.

Abilities sit toward the middle and ends of the trees.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.6:
§lAbilities§r

Unlocked spells and techniques go on the ability wheel.

Hold §l%2$s§r to choose one, press §l%3$s§r to cast it.

Epic Fight skills go in the Combat Skills box on the Abilities screen.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.7:
§lMana§r

Spells and techniques cost mana. Mana stops refilling while you spend it and starts again one second after.

Tree bonuses raise your mana, regen and cooldown reduction.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.8:
§lRespec§r

%1$s → Respec lets you reset a tree (every point back) or swap one class for another.

A new class starts at three quarters of the old one's level.
guide.mdvlcraft.page.9:
§lDowned§r

At zero health you bleed out instead of dying straight away. Another player can revive you by holding use (right-click) on you.

Hold §l%4$s§r to give up.

Good luck.
